verdict.rationale: Veriff's watchlist-screening-webhook explicitly returns data from PEP & Sanctions, adverse media, and 'ongoing monitoring (OGM)' services, indicating previously verified users are continuously re-screened and events pushed to the ops team, and PEP & Sanctions checks are also offered as an add-on. However missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of re-screening cadence or configuration options, detail on how watchlist changes are surfaced/actioned in the Customer Portal for ongoing monitoring specifically, and any customer testimonial validating continuous monitoring in production.
